comment: Price list for the AI assistant window (tind-ai-ask): the coloured mark next to each model and the Prices page. Data, not code; updated with Tind updates, never fetched. Prices are per million tokens, input and output, in the provider's own currency, before VAT. A model's band comes from a blend of 3 parts input to 1 part output: under limits.cheap is cheap, under limits.mid is mid, anything above is expensive. A provider listed under free costs nothing per token (this computer); a model with no entry here (for example a custom server's) is shown as price unknown. note is shown under the price; checked false means the figure is not on the provider's own price page.

gpt-oss-120b.note: The first million tokens are free.

mistral-medium-3.5-128b.note: Not on Scaleway's own price page on 3 Nov 2026; figure from a third-party list.

mistral-medium-latest.note: Mistral Medium 3.5, which Mistral retired on 31 Oct 2026; figure from a third-party list.

claude-haiku-5-5.note: For messages up to 100,000 tokens; longer ones cost five times as much.
